name: acentric-repo
description: The Acentric repository: the engine, the framework, the command and the machine daemon.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/agent && node apps/cli/scripts/vendor.ts && tsc -b && node apps/cli/scripts/bundle.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm versions && pnpm test
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
